page.overview:
Who is Bernado "the Rat"?

Bernado, nicknamed the Rat, was a Tilean landlord who relieved honest farmers of their grain.

He was brought to justice by Rodrigo Delmonte with fatal consequences. When The Alcatani Fellowship executed him, he was unreasonable to the end.

Considering Delmonte had a quarrel with El Cadavo it can be estimated that Bernado lived around the 20th century IC.
